reply.practice: - For a launch post, always add alt text and the link. A reader who cannot see the image or find the feature moves on.
reply.direct: - For a launch post, add alt text, the link, the hashtags and the brand mark, so people can find it.
reply.split:
- For a launch post, write alt text that says what the image shows. A reader using a screen reader gets the post from it.
- End the text with the link and the hashtags. A tag in the middle of a sentence breaks it.
- Put the Skill Studio mark in a corner of the image. A screenshot shared without the post still says whose it is.

reply.practice: - Write as one colleague writes to another: plain words, no exclamation marks. A post that reads like an ad gets skipped.
reply.direct: - Write in plain words, with no exclamation marks.
